synthesis.appearance_hypotheses: Repeated model-generated captions included a green background with a black and white pattern (2 frames); a colorful abstract background with squares and squares (2 frames); a black and white background with a pattern (2 frames). Frequent prompt-relative hypotheses: light: soft diffuse lighting (24/32 frames); material: smooth digital surfaces (27/32 frames); medium: a 3D render (28/32 frames); setting: an abstract composition (29/32 frames); tone: a tense ominous image (22/32 frames). Frequent optional PixelCue tag hypotheses: FaceIdentity (3).
synthesis.audio_control: 16 matched programme-versus-silence comparisons had median hue divergence 0.029 bits. Differences may also reflect unseeded projectM rendering or feedback evolution, not just musical response.

Still frames cannot establish flash safety or perceived motion quality. Only an authenticated artist-provided suite can establish behaviour on actual album audio.

synthesis.scope: Observed 32 paired source/output measurements across 8 declared conditions, including 2 cover/lyric conditions and output times 0, 0.5, 1.5, 3 seconds.
synthesis.temporal_behaviour: For successive captures of the same input condition, median measured texture divergence was 0.067 bits across 24 transitions.
